assessment: No verified later full solution identified. October 2026 primary source still retains target unmarked. This is bounded research, not a proof of global absence.
source_proof_caveats: The inspected arXiv v4 Lemma 3.6 proof has an index typo: the cyclic index at lower-central step i is p^(i-1), not p^i; the p=2 y-indexing at the end also needs a shift. The author reconstruction uses the correct lower-central formula.

The arXiv v4 Lemma 3.7 proof contains an overstrong binomial-divisibility sentence: binomial(9,3)=84 is not divisible by 9. The intended odd-prime congruence can be proved correctly, and the author valuation/counting proof avoids this sentence entirely.
The cyclic-complement description in v4 Example 3.8 cannot be used for p=2. The author reconstruction correctly uses all units congruent to 1 modulo p and never assumes that complement cyclic.
